indicator_definition: Share of rail in total inland passenger transport, expressed as a percentage of passenger-kilometres. Reflects use of sustainable alternatives to private cars. Data compiled by Eurostat from national transport statistics.
rationale: Rail transport is more energy-efficient and less polluting than private cars. Progress means an increasing share of rail in total passenger transport.
methodology_characteristics: Data compiled by Eurostat from national transport statistics. Measured in passenger-kilometres. Rail compared to total inland passenger transport. Published annually.
indicator_name: Share of rail transport in passenger transport
graph_title: Share of rail transport in passenger transport
